About
I build quantitative models for credit, mortgages and derivatives. At Figure Lending I built the HELOC prepayment model behind the cash flow projections its securitizations were priced on. Before that I spent two and a half years in Home Lending credit risk at JPMorgan Chase, and most recently I was a research associate at Harvard Business School, working on how AI is changing startups. I hold an MS in Financial Engineering from the University of Illinois.
My code is on GitHub, and the projects page has a short note on each. Feel free to email me.

title: Education
text: I completed an MS in Financial Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign in December 2025, as part of a diverse and dynamic cohort. The program gave me with a rigorous curriculum that combines quantitative finance and computational techniques with real-world applications. Courses like Numerical Methods, Stochastic Calculus, and Financial Computing together with courses like Financial Derivatives and Applied portfolio management have developed my quantitative skills, while group projects and case studies have fostered a spirit of collaboration and innovation. This enriching experience has equipped me to tackle the challenges of modern financial markets with confidence and adaptability.  I got the opportunity to meet people who come from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds, bringing unique perspectives to the program. Working together on projects, presentations, and problem-solving tasks has been an invaluable experience, allowing us to grow not only academically but also personally. This image reminds me of the supportive environment we have cultivated, which continues to inspire and motivate me to excel in my journey toward becoming a well-rounded financial engineer.  Studying at BITS Pilani was a transformative chapter in my academic and personal journey. It was here that I developed a strong foundation in Engineering while exploring my interest in Finance through a diverse curriculum. Beyond academics, the vibrant campus life allowed me to engage in various extracurricular activities, fostering lifelong friendships and enriching my leadership and teamwork skills. This pic reminds me of the pride and camaraderie I shared with my peers, embodying the values of excellence and innovation that BITS Pilani instilled in us.

title: Interests
text: I’ve always loved gaming—chess, in particular, is a favorite because it’s such a great way to challenge my mind and strategy skills. Cooking is another passion of mine; it’s relaxing, creative, and a way to connect with others. But what truly makes me happy is giving back. I enjoy working with charitable organizations and being involved in social services. It’s incredibly rewarding to know I’m making a difference, even in small ways, and helping to bring a little more positivity into the world.

title: Projects
text: All of these are on GitHub, each with its code and results.

title: Projects
text:
NVIX and volatility
Which kinds of front-page news predict stock market volatility, 1926 to 2016. The news measure was fitted to implied volatility over 1996 to 2009, so every claim is tested on the windows the text model never saw.

title: Projects
section: Joint SPX and VIX calibration with a neural SDE
text:
Joint SPX and VIX calibration with a neural SDE
From a J.P. Morgan-sponsored practicum: a neural stochastic volatility model fitted to SPX options, VIX options and VIX futures at once. My part was how the fit is judged and trained: bid-ask coverage and deviation metrics, dynamic loss weights and warm-started recalibration.

title: Projects
text:
Agency MBS prepayment
Prepayment speeds, credit stratification and loss severity on Fannie Mae loan performance data. When rates dipped in September 2024, loans from early 2023 over $400k went from 7.6% CPR in July to 16.0% in October, while loans from early 2022 did not move.

title: Projects
text:
Heston calibration
A Heston pricer checked against Black-Scholes, adaptive quadrature and Monte Carlo, and calibrated to 1,434 live SPX option quotes.

title: Projects
text:
Forecasting the VIX
Walk-forward forecasts one day and one month ahead. A three-term HAR regression beats a random forest and a neural network a month out.

title: Projects
section: Option pricing in C++ and by PDE
text:
Option pricing in C++ and by PDE
Barrier options by Monte Carlo with a Brownian-bridge correction and variance reduction, trinomial trees with Richardson extrapolation, and a Crank-Nicolson solver for European, American and barrier options with a convergence study.

title: Projects
text:
More
Linear programs in finance, ARMA-GARCH models of S&P 500 volatility, defensive allocation for the Cornell case competition and a sector signal backtest.

title: Projects
section: Rainfall & Runoff Prediction Using Advanced Neural Networks
text:
Rainfall & Runoff Prediction Using Advanced Neural Networks
This project focused on optimizing Wavelet Neural Network (WNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models to predict rainfall and runoff patterns in the Lower Godavari Basin. Historical time-series data such as temperature, humidity, longitude, and latitude were leveraged to enhance model accuracy. A Graphical User Interface (GUI) was developed to simplify the interaction and implementation of both models, paving the way for future research in hydrological forecasting.

title: Projects
section: Portfolio Optimization Using Monte Carlo Simulation
text:
Portfolio Optimization Using Monte Carlo Simulation
This project aimed to identify the Markowitz optimal return by employing Monte Carlo Simulation techniques. Using Python, portfolio optimization techniques were applied to balance risk and return, providing actionable investment strategies for diverse market scenarios.

title: Projects
section: Hidden Markov Model for Risk and Return Prediction
text:
Hidden Markov Model for Risk and Return Prediction
In this project, Hidden Markov Models (HMM) were developed using the Python hmmlearn library to predict financial returns and Value at Risk (VaR). The HMM framework enabled capturing the probabilistic transitions of market states, offering valuable insights for strategic financial decision-making.

title: Projects
text:
Revenue Forecasting & Risk Analysis
This project involved forecasting revenue growth for a dataset with over 4,000 features. Techniques such as Stochastic Gradient Descent, advanced optimization, and hyperparameter tuning were employed using Python libraries like JAX and Optax. The project also explored Hidden Markov Models for predicting returns and calculating Value at Risk, alongside Monte Carlo Simulation for portfolio optimization and risk analysis.

title: Projects
text:
Comprehensive Business Risk Evaluation
A robust analysis of business risks, including systematic and unsystematic risks, was conducted to evaluate financial, operational, and total leverage for competitor firms. Using financial models and simulations, the project aimed to interpret optimal capital structures for publicly traded stocks. This comprehensive approach provided actionable insights into business dynamics and capital strategy.
